up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727368. The document is stored in the docs table (chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727368'). List each molecule's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and, if available, the compound name and compound key from the compound record that links the molecule to this document. Also include the canonical SMILES of the molecule. The connections are: docs.doc_id → compound_records.doc_id (via the doc_id foreign key), and compound_records.molregno → molecule_dictionary.molregno. Add the SMILES via molecule_dictionary.molregno → compound_structures.molregno. Do not impose any other filters; return all qualifying molecules.
sql:
SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       md.pref_name,
       cr.compound_name,
       cr.compound_key,
       cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727368';
